module: Flowgraph node "On Poi Prompt Shown" (category repeat_instant, ui color/icon). Detects that the player has stopped at a point of interest and the prompt (missions, dealership, garage, refueling) is shown. One-frame impulse outputs: shownPrompt (prompt shown, including garage and fuel) and openedMenu (mission list sent to the UI).

work.desc: Every frame: sets both outputs back to false, applies and clears the flags.
